notes.title: Summer Sale 2023
notes.notes:
Summer has arrived, bringing with it the warmth of sunshine and the excitement of this sizzling Summer Sale! As the days get longer and the temperature rises, there's no better time to dive into some thrilling gaming adventures and enjoy fantastic deals. 

Embrace the spirit of the season with our incredible discounts on all titles in our vast catalog. We have something for everyone, whether you're craving action, adventure, or strategy. Enjoy captivating and exciting games like Human Fall Flat, The Ascent, Blooming Business: Casino, From Space, and the adventurous Patch Quest.  

So, grab your sunglasses, controller, mouse & keyboard, and get ready for a very hot gaming summer! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/curvedigital/sale/curvesummer][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/854f506495036857d1dff23e769c6769033079d9.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Badlands Crew  
[/h1]
Join the crew and become a protector of The Citadel!  

Customize your battle wagon with a wide range of components and weapons, transforming it into a formidable force. Manage your crew's actions individually in combat, from manning guns to repairing vehicle components. Navigate hazardous environments and face off against savage militia groups led by crazed Warlords. Make strategic decisions that shape the campaign map and influence faction control.  

Your choices and skills will determine your success, plan wisely and fight fiercely! Wishlist and start your adventure into the lawless Badlands!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078230/

[h1]Dungeons of Hinterberg  
[/h1]
Grab your sword and prepare for an unforgettable adventure in the enchanting alpine village of Hinterberg!  

Join Luisa to conquer the mysterious Dungeons of Hinterberg. Immerse yourself in the breathtaking beauty of this idyllic Austrian Alps destination as you navigate the charming village and uncover the hidden magic within its dungeons. Prepare yourself for a vacation like no other, where adventure and magic intertwine in the alpine paradise.  

Wishlist and join Luisa on the path to becoming a Master Slayer! Welcome to Hinterberg, where the magic of the dungeons awaits your arrival! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983260/

[h1]Kitbash Model Club 
[/h1]
Welcome to the sun-kissed paradise of Wirraway Island! 

Prepare for an exhilarating adventure where innovation meets limitless possibilities. Here, you have the power to transform your most daring RC model construction dreams into tangible reality. Unleash your creativity and push the boundaries of performance.  

Wish list now and embark on this extraordinary journey today and watch as your imagination takes flight! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2107090/Kitbash_Model_Club/

[h1]Goblin Stone 
[/h1]
Attention, Gobbos! 

A new Dev Blog is out; check all the recent news about Goblin Stone and get ready to fight back! Goblins, orcs, and other monster folk rise against extinction. Wishlist now and join the Goblins in their fight for survival in this roguelike-turned-based RPG. Together, we will triumph! 

Onward, brave souls! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521970/Goblin_Stone/

[h1]For The King II  
[/h1]
Inspired by classic tabletop adventures. Prepare to confront Fahrul's once beloved Queen turned tyrant and her army of fearsome Queensguard in the highly anticipated sequel to For The King.  

Whether alone or with a party of four, unravel dark secrets, battle, loot and experience the thrill of this turn-based roguelike RPG.  Discover a host of fresh features, fearsome enemies and devilish dungeons across brand new epic campaigns.  Wishlist the game now and embark on a quest like no other. The Resistance is rising, join us Adventurers! 

Don’t miss the Curve bundles selection. Take advantage of this Sale, save money, and enjoy the spring season by adding some terrific games to your collection!

notes.title: Curve Games Access Sport Bundle is here! 🎮
notes.notes:
Access Sport has launched an esports & gaming campaign to raise funds to make grass roots sport more inclusive! You can sign up here and stream your sports & esports content for rewards https://accesssport.org.uk/streaming-for-sport  

To celebrate we have created our Access Sport Bundle including all our sporting classics: Hotshot Racing, Golf Gang, Pumped BMX+, Pump BMX Pro, Stikbold. 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29043/Curve_Access_Sport_Bundle/

[quote]Access Sport is a UK charity providing opportunities for vulnerable and disabled young people to change their lives through sport and physical activity. We do this by training, equipping and supporting community sports clubs, organisations and volunteers to provide inclusive programmes, unleashing their potential to transform the lives of under-served young people in their local communities.

We work across all sports - team sports such as football, basketball, hockey and rugby, through to sports such as tennis, climbing, yoga, boxing and many more. In some sports, such as BMX Cycling, we have developed whole programmes resulting in new opportunities for tens of thousands of young people. This video explains more: 

[previewyoutube=_MOIu3ExqkY;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_MOIu3ExqkY
[/previewyoutube]
All the games in this sale will be donating a portion of their net profits to Access Sport, so by purchasing games you will be directly helping us give more young people a chance to play sport. 

Access Sport is grateful to all the publishers that have supported this sale, especially the team at Curve Games whose incredible support has enabled us to create this page.

To find out more about how Access Sport works with the video games community and our #streamingforsport campaign which includes the chance for streamers to win an Olympic BMX bike, please visit our website [url=https://www.accesssport.org.uk/video-game-partners]here[/url]. [/quote]

notes.title: You’ve got to try these Golf Gang workshop courses!
notes.notes:
Hey there, Golfers! 

Golf Gang has been in your hands for a couple months now, and in that time, we’ve seen some incredible creations come through the workshop. 

Nice work, everyone! 

Today, we want to feature some of our favourite workshop creations, to show some love and to put them on your radar if you haven’t already checked them out. So let’s start from the top! 

[h3][b]Fall Gang[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39581673/578c34a8d2c30843d7f0270353fb810d348a1268.png[/img]

This Fall Guys inspired course is just as vibrant and colourful as the real thing! It’s just as fun too, but with a mini-golf twist. 

Creator: Majesté 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2833502554

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39581673/e470f110d4b796f6b4ed7a720ed62944dee8a8a6.png[/img]

notes.title: Golf Gang is the golf racing party game you've been waiting for
notes.notes:
Here we are on Alpine Resort's golf course, Hole 6 to be specific. It's a beautiful day for it; there's a slight north-westerly breeze, but nothing that's going to put me off my game. My polo shirt's tucked in, my trousers are belted, and my beer belly is overhanging. My Nike Tour Classic IV (Pearl White) golf glove firmly grips my mouse, and I tee off. Four quick Golf Gang shots later and I'm on for an Eagle, but then my mate drops a bomb on me, blasting me off the course and into the drink.

As my ball - a stylish, hot pink creation that is, of course, decorated with anime eyes and cat ears - is fished out of the water and reset, I am passed by several other golfers. One is green, moustachioed, and wears a small tree for a hat. The other, believe it or not, is a pufferfish.

With a solid suite of customisation options, Golf Gang is a game that not only plays good, but it looks good too. It's classic mini golf, all gussied up ready for a Saturday night spent with up to eight players, racing their way through six distinctly-themed courses - all of which boast a full 18 hole round each.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Golf Gang is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
We are so excited to announce the official release of the fast-paced, precision racer party game, Golf Gang. Launching today on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1151050/Golf_Gang/]Steam[/url] for £7.99 / $9.99 / €9.99, Golf Gang elevates the competitive mini-golf experience to a random battle of skill, strategy and a little (a lot) of chaos to deliver the most exciting and intense game of mini-golf you’ll ever play! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39581673/2bdeadb0890d9ceb5fc2ae738dba2c8d642475ac.gif[/img]

Celebrate the launch with [i]exclusive launch golf goodies[/i]! 

Redeem the For the King backpack to prepare for your adventures and get under the skin of nogHead as he embarks on a journey of self-discovery through the medium of Golf! - Translation: He hacked himself into another game...  

And what racing, party game would be complete without the perfect backing track. Jam out to all 8 songs with every purchase of Golf Gang, enjoy the sweet, sweet tunes from Golf Gang composed by Synax Error Music. All of this you can get completely for FREE for one week only!  

[previewyoutube=XXaUMru_Llo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]MULTIPLAYER MADNESS[/b]
Hit the ball while it’s moving, and race round the course at breakneck speed. Challenge your friends across Golf Gang’s three game modes and hundreds of holes to show them you’re the one that’s found the sweet spot between frenzy and finesse. 

[b]MOD SCENE[/b]
Bend the rules to your liking and get creative with Golf Gang’s multiplayer modifiers. Combine low gravity, explosive collisions, and bullet time, plus many more. Create thousands of unique ways to play, each more chaotic than the last. 

[b]GOLF FOR GLORY[/b]
Compete with your mates for the top of the leaderboard in addictive time trials, classic, and hybrid modes. Golf Gang is all about that classic “just one more go” feeling, as you sneak in an extra hole or 18 during your lunch break! 


Whatever your golfing party needs, Golf Gang has them covered! We look forward to see what mayhem you all get up to, feel free to share over on our Twitter & Discord! 

Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/PlayGolfGang]@PlayGolfGang [/url]
